name: University of Dundee
description: The University of Dundee is a red brick university founded in 1881. Dundee is ranked within the top 300 universities in the world according to the major global rankings (ARWU, QS, Times and CWTS Leiden) and according to the 2018 Times Higher Education World University Rankings by Subject, Dundee's strongest subjects are Life Sciences, ranked joint 55th in the world and Clinical, Pre-Clinical and Health, ranked joint 86th. The 2018 QS World University Rankings by Subject ranks Life Sciences and Medicine joint 146th in the world. Timestamps Updated
